Skills: 28 (templates/skills/*/, each with SKILL.md). Hooks: 20 (templates/hooks/*.sh — rendered into .claude/hooks/ at install time per PR-39 v0.2.12; source-of-truth lives in templates/). MCP servers: 4 — 3 Python-stack containerized (claude_mcp_servers/{weaviate_mcp,search_mcp,code_embedding_service}) plus 1 system-managed Playwright MCP (npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest, registered by install.py during first-install; opt out with VCT_SKIP_PLAYWRIGHT=1). v0.2.11 MCP simplification: dropped claude_mcp_servers/ollama_mcp/ entirely (chat/read_document/read_image redundant with Claude's native capabilities); narrowed search_mcp to only search_papers (web_search, search_code, fetch_page also redundant with native WebSearch/WebFetch). Ollama remains as embedding INFRASTRUCTURE (qwen3-embedding via container) consumed by weaviate_mcp + code_embedding_service. README + CHANGELOG + this file MUST stay in sync with these. name: VibeCoded Orchestrator
description: The core: 20 hooks, 29 bundled agents, 28 skills, KG + Code Graph, 4 MCP servers (3 containerized + Playwright via npx). Runs locally in Podman/Docker.
_install_runtime_doc: v0.2.20 (Stream 2 follow-up, 2026-05-19): the orchestrator core is the install ROOT, not a module installed BY the launcher — the launcher is shipped INSIDE this clone. The install.method=local + runtime.type=cli entries below are technically correct but largely cosmetic: the launcher binary IS the runtime, and the install path IS the clone directory. They exist so this manifest validates against the same `ModuleManifest::from_json` parser that the schema-rendered Sidebar uses for `get_module_nav_items`, allowing the orchestrator core's `gui.config_tab` to be discovered through the same code path as any paid module. The slim `OrchestratorManifest` deserializer in `commands/modules.rs::read_orchestrator_manifest` continues to ignore these fields (serde is permissive by default; no `deny_unknown_fields`).

_bundled_secrets_doc: 0.2.0 fork-readiness sweep (item H1, 2026-05-08): the orchestrator core declares the secrets the launcher itself manages (PAT for GitHub auth, etc.) so the hub's `/api/v1/projects/{id}/env` resolver can serve them to bundled wrappers without the user having to install a separate module first. Each entry maps a single keychain slot — the hub uses the SENTINEL_SHARED project_id for shared scope (so all base-host projects see the same value) and the OnboardingWizard's `register_github_pat` writes to the matching slot. 2026-05-10 (post-0.2.0 backlog #6): module_id changed from 'installer' to 'user' so the wizard's writer matches the SecretsPanel 'Shared (this user)' tab's UI_MODULE_BUCKET — registering via either path now lands at the same keychain row instead of two divergent ones. v0.2.18 (Commit 3, 2026-05-18): added `openai_api_key` (scope=shared, module_id=user) so the EmbeddingService can resolve it via the hub for every project. Registration happens via `register_openai_api_key` (OnboardingWizard's OpenAI step + Preferences → Special Secrets). Validation uses the free `GET /v1/models/text-embedding-3-small` endpoint — no token consumption, no billing entry.

bundled_secrets.description: GitHub personal access token written by the launcher's OnboardingWizard via `register_github_pat` AND by the SecretsPanel 'Shared (this user)' tab. Resolved by the hub for every base-host project; consumed by `claude_mcp_servers/search_mcp/wrapper.sh` (renamed to GITHUB_TOKEN) and bundled hooks that need to talk to GitHub.

OpenAI API key for the EmbeddingService. Set via OnboardingWizard OR Preferences → Special Secrets. Resolved by hub for every project; consumed by vco_lib/embedding_service.py when ACTIVE_EMBEDDING=openai or as multi-slot fallback.

config_tab.title: Orchestrator core
config_tab.description: Manage the always-installed KG + Code Graph services. For project-specific assignments use the Identity tab.

controls.text: Per-project KG and shared KG. Stored in Weaviate. Auto-synced on file edits via hooks.

controls.label: Rebuild this project's KG
controls.tooltip: Re-syncs all `knowledge/*.md` files in the currently-selected project into Weaviate. Use when KG search results look stale or files were edited outside Claude Code. ~10s per 100 nodes.
controls.confirm: Rebuild the KG for the currently-selected project? Existing nodes are upserted (not destructive).

controls.label: Check for duplicate KG nodes
controls.tooltip: Runs a near-duplicate scan across the current project's KG (cosine ≥0.95). Surfaces them in a modal so you can merge/delete by hand.

controls.text: Tip: KG search results carry a `score` (0..1) and a `tier` (`summary`/`single_chunk`/`three_chunks`/`full`) based on relevance. Tunable via `KG_TIER_*` env vars in Preferences.
AST-based code entity index (modules, classes, functions, APIs, cross-service interactions). Powers `search_code_graph` MCP.

controls.label: Re-analyze this project's code
controls.tooltip: Walks the project's source tree and rebuilds the code graph. Use when files were renamed/deleted outside Claude Code, or when adding a new language analyzer. ~30s per 1k LOC. Incremental: only re-analyzes changed files.
controls.confirm: Re-analyze the currently-selected project's code? Stale entities for deleted files are pruned.

controls.label: Prune stale code-graph entries
controls.tooltip: Deletes code-graph nodes for files that no longer exist on disk. Useful after large refactors. Non-destructive: re-running `--analyze` recreates them if the files come back.

controls.text: Service health, KG/CodeGraph collection sizes, embedding-backend status.

controls.label: Run health check
controls.tooltip: Probes Weaviate, Ollama, the code-embedding service, and verifies every project's KG/CodeGraph collections exist. Outputs a per-service status modal. ~3s.

controls.label: Open log directory
controls.tooltip: Reveals `~/.claude/logs/` in your file manager. Useful for grepping recent hook activity or KG-sync runs.
